beneficiariesandassessments.beneregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for the beneficiary or assessment record (e.g., 'BENE0001')

beneficiariesandassessments.benedistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), connecting beneficiaries to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

beneficiariesandassessments.beneopsref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry), linking to the ongoing operations (e.g., 'OPS0001')

beneficiariesandassessments.beneregister.desc: An enum (BeneRegister_enum) describing beneficiary registration; values: 'Complete', 'Pending', 'Partial'

beneficiariesandassessments.vulnerabilit.desc: An enum (VulnerabilityReview_enum) indicating vulnerability assessment; values: 'Complete', 'Pending', 'In Progress'

beneficiariesandassessments.needsassesss.desc: An enum (NeedsAssessStatus_enum) capturing needs assessment status; values: 'Due', 'Overdue', 'Updated'

beneficiariesandassessments.distequityid.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) for distribution equity index (e.g., 0.85)

beneficiariesandassessments.commengagelv.desc: An enum (CommEngageLvl_enum) describing community engagement; values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium'

beneficiariesandassessments.localcapacit.desc: An enum (LocalCapacityGrowth_enum) tracking local capacity building; values: 'Limited', 'Active'

coordinationandevaluation.coordevalregis.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for coordination and evaluation records (e.g., 'COORD0001')

coordinationandevaluation.secincidentcou.desc: An INT logging how many security incidents have occurred (e.g., 2)

coordinationandevaluation.safetyranking.desc: An enum (SafetyRanking_enum) describing safety level; values: 'Safe', 'Moderate', 'High Risk'

coordinationandevaluation.accesslimitati.desc: An enum (AccessLimitation_enum) capturing access restrictions; values: 'Severe', 'Partial'

coordinationandevaluation.coordeffectlvl.desc: An enum (CoordEffectLvl_enum) indicating coordination effectiveness; values: 'Medium', 'Low', 'High'

coordinationandevaluation.partnerorgs.desc: A TEXT field listing partner organizations or supporting groups (e.g., 'NGO-A; LocalGov; RedCross')

coordinationandevaluation.infosharingsta.desc: An enum (InfoSharingState_enum) for information sharing; values: 'Poor', 'Limited', 'Effective'

coordinationandevaluation.reportcomplian.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring compliance with reporting (e.g., 9.0)

coordinationandevaluation.monitoringfreq.desc: An enum (MonitoringFreq_enum) capturing monitoring frequency; values: 'Monthly', 'Daily', 'Weekly'

coordinationandevaluation.evaluationstag.desc: An enum (EvaluationStage_enum) describing current evaluation status; values: 'Overdue', 'Due', 'Current'

coordinationandevaluation.lessonslearned.desc: An enum (LessonsLearnedStage_enum) for how lessons learned documentation is handled; values: 'In Progress', 'Documented', 'Pending'

coordinationandevaluation.contingencypla.desc: An enum (ContingencyPlanStage_enum) for contingency plan status; values: 'Overdue', 'Due', 'Updated'

coordinationandevaluation.riskmitigation.desc: An enum (RiskMitigationSteps_enum) describing risk mitigation actions; values: 'Insufficient', 'Partial', 'Adequate'

coordinationandevaluation.insurancescope.desc: An enum (InsuranceScope_enum) labeling insurance coverage; values: 'Full', 'Partial'

coordinationandevaluation.compliancestat.desc: An enum (ComplianceState_enum) capturing compliance level; values: 'Partial', 'Compliant', 'Non-Compliant'

coordinationandevaluation.auditstate.desc: An enum (AuditState_enum) indicating audit status; values: 'Completed', 'Due', 'Overdue'

coordinationandevaluation.qualitycontrol.desc: An enum (QualityControlSteps_enum) explaining quality control measures; values: 'Moderate', 'Strong', 'Weak'

coordinationandevaluation.mediacoversent.desc: An enum (MediaCoverSentiment_enum) denoting media coverage tone; values: 'Positive', 'Neutral', 'Negative'

coordinationandevaluation.publicpercepti.desc: A DECIMAL(5,1) capturing public perception measure (e.g., 75.2)

coordinationandevaluation.documentations.desc: An enum (DocumentationState_enum) labeling completeness of documentation; values: 'Partial', 'Incomplete', 'Complete'

coordinationandevaluation.lessonsrecorde.desc: A TEXT field noting documented lessons (e.g., 'More pre-disaster drills needed.')

coordinationandevaluation.bestpracticesl.desc: A TEXT field capturing recognized best practices (e.g., 'Daily stand-up meetings, decentralized supply hubs.')

coordinationandevaluation.improvementrec.desc: A TEXT field logging improvement recommendations (e.g., 'Upgrade transport routes, increase staff training.')

coordinationandevaluation.nextreviewdate.desc: A DATE indicating when the next review is scheduled (e.g., '2026-01-15')

coordinationandevaluation.notes.desc: A TEXT field for extra commentary or insights from coordinators, unbounded length

disasterevents.distregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each disaster record (e.g., 'DIST0001')

disasterevents.timemark.desc: A TIMESTAMP indicating when this disaster event record was created (e.g., '2025-04-15 10:30:00')

disasterevents.haztype.desc: An enum (HazType_enum) describing the primary hazard type; possible values include 'Wildfire', 'Earthquake', 'Tsunami', 'Flood', 'Hurricane'

disasterevents.hazlevel.desc: An enum (HazLevel_enum) specifying the hazard’s severity level; possible values include 'Level 1', 'Level 2', 'Level 3', 'Level 4', 'Level 5'

disasterevents.affectedarea.desc: A VARCHAR(100) naming the geographic area impacted by the disaster (e.g., 'Coastal Region')

disasterevents.regiontag.desc: A CHAR(10) tagging the region code (e.g., 'REG001')

disasterevents.latcoord.desc: A NUMERIC(9,6) capturing the latitude coordinate of the affected area (e.g., 34.052235)

disasterevents.loncoord.desc: A DECIMAL(10,7) capturing the longitude coordinate (e.g., -118.243683)

disasterevents.impactmetrics.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates impact-related metrics of the disaster including population effects, infrastructure damage, and communication status

distributionhubs.hubregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key identifying each distribution hub record (e.g., 'HUB0001')

distributionhubs.disteventref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), linking this hub to a specific disaster event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

distributionhubs.hubcaptons.desc: A DECIMAL(11,2) for the hub’s maximum capacity in tons (e.g., 350.00)

distributionhubs.hubutilpct.desc: A DECIMAL(7,3) showing the percentage of hub capacity currently utilized (e.g., 85.300)

distributionhubs.storecapm3.desc: A NUMERIC(9,2) representing total storage capacity in cubic meters (e.g., 2000.00)

distributionhubs.storeavailm3.desc: A DECIMAL(8,3) specifying how many cubic meters of storage remain available (e.g., 450.750)

distributionhubs.coldstorecapm3.desc: A DECIMAL(10,3) indicating cold-storage capacity in cubic meters (e.g., 150.300)

distributionhubs.coldstoretempc.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) for the temperature in the cold storage facility (e.g., -5.0)

distributionhubs.warehousestate.desc: An enum (WarehouseState_enum) describing the warehouse’s condition; values: 'Fair', 'Excellent', 'Good', 'Poor'

distributionhubs.invaccpct.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) representing inventory accuracy as a percentage (e.g., 98.50)

distributionhubs.stockturnrate.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) measuring how often inventory is turned over during a specific period (e.g., 5.20)

environmentandhealth.envhealthregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key identifying each environment and health record (e.g., 'ENVH0001')

environmentandhealth.envdistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), linking environment/health data to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

environmentandhealth.envimpactrate.desc: An enum (EnvImpactRate_enum) rating environmental impact; values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium'

environmentandhealth.wastemanagementstat.desc: An enum (WasteManagementState_enum) describing waste management capability; values: 'Adequate', 'Limited', 'Critical'

environmentandhealth.recyclepct.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) capturing the recycling rate percentage (e.g., 10.5)

environmentandhealth.carbontons.desc: A DECIMAL(10,3) counting carbon emissions in tons (e.g., 250.000)

environmentandhealth.renewenergypct.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) logging what percent of energy usage is renewable (e.g., 15.50)

environmentandhealth.sanitationcoverage.desc: A NUMERIC(7,3) representing sanitation coverage percentage (e.g., 92.500)

environmentandhealth.diseaserisk.desc: An enum (DiseaseRisk_enum) for disease outbreak threat; values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'

environmentandhealth.medicalemergencycap.desc: An enum (MedicalEmergencyCapacity_enum) capturing medical emergency readiness; values: 'Adequate', 'Critical', 'Limited'

environmentandhealth.vaccinationcoverage.desc: A DECIMAL(6,3) showing percent of population vaccinated (e.g., 85.200)

environmentandhealth.mentalhealthaid.desc: An enum (MentalHealthAid_enum) measuring mental health support; values: 'Limited', 'Available'

financials.financeregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each financial record (e.g., 'FIN0001')

financials.findistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), tying finances to a specific event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

financials.finopsref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry), linking finances to operations (e.g., 'OPS0001')

financials.budgetallotusd.desc: A DECIMAL(16,3) for the allocated budget in USD (e.g., 1000000.000)

financials.fundsutilpct.desc: A DECIMAL(7,3) measuring percentage of utilized funds (e.g., 75.500)

financials.costbeneusd.desc: A NUMERIC(14,3) capturing the cost per beneficiary in USD (e.g., 15.250)

financials.opscostsusd.desc: A DECIMAL(15,2) describing total operational costs (e.g., 350000.00)

financials.personnelcostsusd.desc: A DECIMAL(15,4) enumerating personnel costs in USD (e.g., 50000.0000)

financials.fundingstate.desc: An enum (FundingState_enum) labeling funding status; values: 'Critical', 'Adequate', 'Limited'

financials.donorcommitmentsusd.desc: A DECIMAL(14,2) representing pledged donor funds (e.g., 200000.00)

financials.resourcegapsusd.desc: An INT recording the gap in resources needed (e.g., 50000)

humanresources.hrregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for the human resources record (e.g., 'HR0001')

humanresources.hrdistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), associating staff with an event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

humanresources.hropsref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry), linking staff resources to operations (e.g., 'OPS0001')

humanresources.staffingprofile.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates staffing information, including personnel counts by specialty, volunteer resources, and operational readiness metrics

operations.opsregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for each operations record (e.g., 'OPS0001')

operations.opsdistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), tying these operations to a disaster (e.g., 'DIST0001')

operations.opshubref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DistributionHubs(HubRegistry), associating operations with a particular hub (e.g., 'HUB0001')

operations.emerglevel.desc: An enum (EmergLevel_enum) labeling the emergency level; possible values: 'Black', 'Orange', 'Red', 'Yellow'

operations.respphase.desc: An enum (RespPhase_enum) for the disaster response phase; possible values: 'Reconstruction', 'Recovery', 'Emergency', 'Initial'

operations.opsstatus.desc: An enum (OpsStatus_enum) showing the operation’s status; values: 'Completed', 'Scaling Down', 'Active', 'Planning'

operations.coordcenter.desc: A VARCHAR(80) describing the coordination center or command location (e.g., 'Central Ops HQ')

operations.opsstartdate.desc: A DATE indicating when operations began (e.g., '2025-04-01')

operations.estdurationdays.desc: An INT estimating how many days the operation will last (e.g., 30)

operations.priorityrank.desc: An enum (PriorityRank_enum) defining the priority level; possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Critical'

operations.resourceallocstate.desc: An enum (ResourceAllocState_enum) describing resource allocation; possible values: 'Limited', 'Critical', 'Sufficient'

operations.supplyflowstate.desc: An enum (SupplyFlowState_enum) indicating supply chain flow status; possible values: 'Disrupted', 'Stable', 'Strained'

supplies.supplyregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key identifying each supplies record (e.g., 'SUP0001')

supplies.supplydistref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry) to link supplies to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001')

supplies.supplyhubref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DistributionHubs(HubRegistry), tying supplies to a particular hub (e.g., 'HUB0001')

supplies.resourceinventory.desc: JSONB column. Provides a comprehensive view of all supply resources available for disaster response, including food, water, shelter, medical, and power-related

transportation.transportregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the transportation record (e.g., 'TRANS0001')

transportation.transporthubref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing DistributionHubs(HubRegistry), linking transport to a hub (e.g., 'HUB0001')

transportation.transportsupref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing Supplies(SupplyRegistry), connecting transport operations to supplies (e.g., 'SUP0001')

transportation.vehiclecount.desc: An INT recording how many vehicles are assigned (e.g., 15)

transportation.trucksavailable.desc: An INT counting the number of trucks available (e.g., 5)

transportation.helosavailable.desc: An INTEGER specifying how many helicopters are available (e.g., 2)

transportation.boatsavailable.desc: A BIGINT measuring how many boats can be used (e.g., 1)

transportation.totaldeliverytons.desc: A DECIMAL(9,3) for the total cargo capacity in tons (e.g., 50.000)

transportation.dailydeliverytons.desc: A DECIMAL(8,2) capturing daily delivery capacity in tons (e.g., 7.50)

transportation.lastmilestatus.desc: An enum (LastMileStatus_enum) indicating last-mile delivery progress; values: 'On Track', 'Delayed', 'Suspended'

transportation.distributionpoints.desc: An INTEGER labeling how many drop-off or distribution points exist (e.g., 10)

transportation.avgdeliveryhours.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) measuring average hours per delivery route (e.g., 8.50)

transportation.deliverysuccessrate.desc: A DECIMAL(7,3) describing the delivery success percentage (e.g., 95.200)

transportation.routeoptstatus.desc: An enum (RouteOptStatus_enum) describing routing optimization; values: 'In Progress', 'Optimized', 'Required'

transportation.fuelefficiencylpk.desc: A DECIMAL(6,3) logging liters of fuel used per km (e.g., 0.250)

transportation.maintenancestate.desc: An enum (MaintenanceState_enum) capturing maintenance status; values: 'Overdue', 'Up to Date', 'Due'

transportation.vehiclebreakrate.desc: A DECIMAL(4,1) measuring how often vehicles break down, as a rate (e.g., 2.5)
